request.description:
Raised by PM in shift 5 (2026-11-18T16:33Z) after correcting FOUR wrong card descriptions in one shift.

THE GAP: `project_manager action='update_task'` rejects a `description` argument ("Nothing to update: provide at least one of status, board, column, sprints, sprint, priority, due_date, wake_at, progress, assignees or tags"). A task's description/body is writable only ONCE, at `create_task`. After that there is no supported way to correct it, so a wrong body persists forever at the top of the card while corrections pile up in the comment thread below it.

WHY IT MATTERS (real occurrences this shift, all in the efforts increment):
- `a0f362ed` body says "Expect 8 `ok -` lines" and `node tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`; truth is 9 cases and `node --test tests/effortsApi.test.mjs`. The body cannot be fixed. Owner reads the body first.
- `675c4695` body said "reword" the HTML comment; the correct action is DELETE it (a reworded comment is still an added comment and can be re-flagged). Settled only by a comment, so the body still contradicts it.
- `91411767` body listed "add the test script" as step 1; `package.json:14` already had it.
- `0bc8b144` body says "3 files + 1 hunk"; the measured scope is 4 paths with the fix under `global_settings/`, not `kanban/`.
- `a0f362ed` also carried a wake_at (11-20 14:00Z) later than the commit it gates (11-19 13:00Z) — that one WAS fixable, because wake_at is mutable.

MODES OF FAILURE: (a) owner follows the body and does the wrong thing; (b) owner "passes" a card without doing the work because the body described work already done; (c) a contradiction between body and comment is resolved inconsistently by whoever arrives first.

OPTIONS:
1. Support `description` on `update_task` (rewrite the body; prefer appending a `## PM amendment` block so history is not destroyed).
2. Keep bodies immutable but add an explicit `superseded_by` / `authoritative_comment_id` pointer rendered above the body.
3. Minimum viable: render a visible banner on the card when comments exist and the body is older than the last comment — "body may be stale, read the latest comment".

RECOMMENDATION: option 1 with append semantics (option 3 as a cheap interim). Anything that leaves the owner reading a known-wrong instruction costs more than it saves.

ACCEPTANCE: a PM can correct a wrong task body through the task tools, and the correction is visible at the top of the card without reading the comment thread.

This card does NOT block the efforts increment. It is a process/tooling defect in the kanban layer, not in the product.
